name: Nekomura Akiho
source:
A childhood friend of the protagonist, who works as a nurse at Amanogawa General Hospital.
She attended the same elementary school as Minoru, and was close friends with him and his sister, Miyo.
A chance encounter at the hospital leads to an awkward situation.

She is responsible and caring, the kind of person who cannot simply walk away when someone is in need.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
